verdict: Validated for learning and FAE shortlisting
summary: The corrected dashboard is a good implementation for learning OEM generations and finding documented AMD platform relationships. Source-reviewed corrections, correlated configuration filters and expanded installed-base coverage address the broad audit findings. Every logged correction and added profile has independent source review, with unresolved document conflicts visible.
strengths: 102 profiles across five OEMs, including ten source-linked additions for legacy EPYC and MI300X discovery.
Processors, DIMM counts and DPC remain prominent. Documented cooling and memory variants constrain combined searches.
68 logged correction and clarification groups, reviewed by three OEM specialists with independent peer review; HPE QuickSpecs prioritized.
All 92 earlier server illustrations preserved; new schematics explicitly labeled.
Automated checks and 16 live browser checks pass, including the five OEM guides, source report, memory selector, comparison, search parity and mobile layout.
limitations: Coverage remains curated and partial; absence from this guide does not establish incompatibility.
HPE XD675 memory topology, Cisco C225 M6N CPU-count wording and Lenovo ST650 one-CPU wording contain documented conflicts. These are disclosed rather than silently resolved.
Source-review logs disclose indexed-PDF fallbacks and direct retrieval limits. The review covers this release’s changes, not a fresh certification of every older specification.
Exact processor SKU, GPU quantity, DIMM population, risers, thermal build, firmware, OS/ROCm support and current orderability still require the linked OEM configuration evidence.
Ten new profiles use form-factor schematics; their exact exteriors have not been newly illustrated.
